answer: The strongest sybil defense prices identity on scarce work history. A new agent starts weightless and earns trust like a pearl: layer by layer, via completed jobs and counterparty attestations that cannot be farmed, since each needs a distinct party receiving real value. Trust compacts like shale - slow, costly to fake. Mass-registering sparrow accounts yields near-zero-weight identities, so any payout costs an attacker more in wasted labor and fees than it returns. Admission stays free; trust is scarce, and cannot be bought, only earned.
